```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(glmnet)
library(pROC)
library(performance)
library(rstatix)
library(car)
library(broom)
library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(corrr)

set.seed(123)
options(scipen = 999, digits = 4)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

load_features <- function(path = "features.csv", drop_outliers = TRUE) {
  df <- read.csv(path)
  
  if (drop_outliers) {
    # Tukeys IQR Rule
    q1 <- quantile(df$eda_tonic_mean, 0.25)
    q3 <- quantile(df$eda_tonic_mean, 0.75)
    iqr <- q3 - q1
    lower <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
    upper <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
    
    # Identify outlier subjects (any with values outside bounds)
    outlier_subjects <- unique(df$subject[df$eda_tonic_mean < lower | df$eda_tonic_mean > upper])
    
    # Drop full subjects if any of their rows are outliers
    df_clean <- df[!df$subject %in% outlier_subjects, ]
    
    # Subjects that were dropped entirely
    dropped_subjects <- setdiff(unique(df$subject), unique(df_clean$subject))
    
    print(message <- paste("Dropped subjects:", paste(as.integer(dropped_subjects), collapse = ", ")))
    
    # Normalize tonic EDA per subject
    df <- df_clean
    
    df <- df |>
      group_by(subject) |>
      mutate(
        across(contains("eda_tonic"), ~ scale(.x)[,1])
      ) |>
      ungroup()
  }
  
  eda_vars <<- df |> 
    select(contains(c("eda", "scr"))) |> 
    names()
  
  return(df)
}
```

## Boxplot Analysis

```{r}
df_with_outliers <- load_features(drop_outliers = FALSE)
```


Drop outliers for further analysis (Tukey Method):

```{r}
df <- load_features(drop_outliers = TRUE)
```

## Two-way ANOVA

```{r}
anova_out <- aov(eda_tonic_mean ~ dark * stimulus, data = df)
kable(tidy(anova_out), caption = "ANOVA: eda_tonic_mean ~ dark * stimulus")
```

### Assumptions for ANOVA

**Levene's Test**:

```{r}
levene_out <- leveneTest(eda_tonic_mean ~ interaction(dark, stimulus), data = df)
kable(levene_out, caption = "Levene's Test for Homogeneity of Variance")
```

**Shapiro-Wilk Test**:

```{r}
shapiro_out <- shapiro.test(residuals(anova_out))
kable(tidy(shapiro_out))
```

## Friedman Test

```{r}
map_dfr(eda_vars, \(var) {
  # Prepare data
  df_friedman <- df |> 
    select(subject, condition_type, !!sym(var)) |> 
    arrange(subject, condition_type)
  
  # Friedman test
  friedman_res <- friedman_test(
    as.formula(paste(var, "~ condition_type | subject")),
    data = df_friedman
  )
  
  # Effect size (Kendall's W)
  effsize_res <- friedman_effsize(
    as.formula(paste(var, "~ condition_type | subject")),
    data = df_friedman
  )
  
  # Combine results
  tibble(
    Variable = var,
    `Test Statistic` = friedman_res$statistic,
    `df` = friedman_res$df,
    `P-value` = format.pval(friedman_res$p, digits = 3),
    `Kendall's W` = effsize_res$effsize,
    `Effect Size Magnitude` = effsize_res$magnitude
  )
}) |>
  kable(caption = "Friedman Tests and Effect Sizes across condition_type")
```

## Paired Wilcoxon Tests

```{r}
df_wide <- df |>
  group_by(subject, dark) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(eda_vars), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = dark, values_from = all_of(eda_vars), names_sep = "_") |>
  drop_na()

map_dfr(eda_vars, \(var) {
  x <- df_wide[[paste0(var, "_0")]]
  y <- df_wide[[paste0(var, "_1")]]
  w <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x, y, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE))
  z <- qnorm(w$p.value / 2, lower.tail = FALSE) * sign(median(y - x, na.rm = TRUE))
  r <- z / sqrt(length(x))
  tibble(
    Variable = var,
    P = signif(w$p.value, 3),
    r = round(r, 3),
    Interpretation = case_when(
      abs(r) < 0.1 ~ "negligible",
      abs(r) < 0.3 ~ "small",
      abs(r) < 0.5 ~ "medium",
      TRUE ~ "large"
    ),
    Median_Diff = median(y - x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}) |>
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Paired Wilcoxon Tests with Effect Sizes for dark") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped")
```

## Logistic Regression

```{r}
check_separation <- function(df, response_var, predictors) {
  temp <- df |>
      select(all_of(c(response_var, predictors)))
  df_check <- temp[complete.cases(temp), ]
  
  # Check each predictor for perfect separation
  separation_issues <- map_dfr(predictors, function(pred) {
    if (is.numeric(df_check[[pred]])) {
      # For continuous variables, check if all 1s are above all 0s or vice versa
      response_0 <- df_check[[pred]][df_check[[response_var]] == 0]
      response_1 <- df_check[[pred]][df_check[[response_var]] == 1]
      
      if (length(response_0) > 0 & length(response_1) > 0) {
        separated <- max(response_0, na.rm = TRUE) < min(response_1, na.rm = TRUE) | 
                    max(response_1, na.rm = TRUE) < min(response_0, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        separated <- TRUE  # One group is empty
      }
    } else {
      # For categorical, check if any category predicts perfectly
      tab <- table(df_check[[pred]], df_check[[response_var]])
      separated <- any(rowSums(tab == 0) == ncol(tab) - 1)
    }
    
    tibble(predictor = pred, perfect_separation = separated)
  })
  
  problematic <- filter(separation_issues, perfect_separation)
  if (nrow(problematic) > 0) {
    cat("Warning: Perfect separation detected for:", paste(problematic$predictor, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    cat("Consider removing these predictors or using penalized regression\n")
  }
}

run_logistic <- function(df_in, response_var) {
  # Helper: prune highly correlated predictors (|r| > 0.9)
  prune_by_corr <- function(dat, vars, cutoff = 0.9) {
    x <- dat |> dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(vars)) %>% dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(.))
    if (ncol(x) <= 1) return(vars)
    cm <- stats::cor(x)
    to_drop <- character(0)
    for (i in seq_len(ncol(cm) - 1)) {
      if (colnames(cm)[i] %in% to_drop) next
      high <- colnames(cm)[(i + 1):ncol(cm)][abs(cm[(i + 1):ncol(cm), i]) > cutoff]
      to_drop <- union(to_drop, high)
    }
    setdiff(vars, to_drop)
  }

  # Prepare data
  df_filtered <- if (response_var == "granted") {
    filter(df_in, !(stimulus %in% c("cookies", "newsletter") & dark == 1))
  } else {
    filter(df_in, (was_fixated == 1))
  }

  # Prune collinear EDA predictors based on df_filtered
  eda_vars_pruned <- prune_by_corr(df_filtered, eda_vars, cutoff = 0.9)

  df_pred_complete <- df_filtered |>
    select(subject, all_of(c(response_var, eda_vars_pruned))) |>
    mutate(!!sym(response_var) := as.factor(!!sym(response_var))) |>
    filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.)))

  # Summary
  participant_ids <- unique(df_pred_complete$subject)
  cat("\n---", response_var, "---\n")
  cat("Observations:", nrow(df_pred_complete),
      "| Participants:", length(participant_ids),
      "| Predictors:", length(eda_vars_pruned), "\n")

  # LOSO Cross-Validation
  loso_results <- map_dfr(participant_ids, function(test_subject) {
    train_data <- filter(df_pred_complete, subject != test_subject)
    test_data  <- filter(df_pred_complete, subject == test_subject)

    model <- glm(paste(response_var, "~ ."),
                 data   = select(train_data, all_of(c(response_var, eda_vars_pruned))),
                 family = binomial,
                 control = glm.control(maxit = 100))
    pred_prob <- predict(model, newdata = test_data, type = "response")
    actual <- as.numeric(as.character(test_data[[response_var]]))

    list(
      accuracy = mean((pred_prob > 0.5) == actual, na.rm = TRUE),
      auc = if (length(unique(actual)) > 1)
              as.numeric(auc(roc(actual, pred_prob, quiet = TRUE)))
            else NA_real_
    )
  }) |> bind_rows()

  # Results
  valid_results <- filter(loso_results, !is.na(accuracy))
  cat("LOSO Accuracy =", round(mean(valid_results$accuracy), 3), "±",
      round(sd(valid_results$accuracy), 3),
      "| AUC =", round(mean(valid_results$auc, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "±",
      round(sd(valid_results$auc, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")

  # Final model
  model_data <- select(df_pred_complete, all_of(c(response_var, eda_vars_pruned)))
  check_separation(model_data, response_var, eda_vars_pruned)
  final_model <- glm(paste(response_var, "~ ."),
                     data   = model_data,
                     family = binomial,
                     control = glm.control(maxit = 100))

  all_coefs <- tidy(final_model) |>
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
    arrange(p.value)

  sig_coefs <- filter(all_coefs, p.value < 0.05)

  if (nrow(sig_coefs) > 0) {
    cat("Found", nrow(sig_coefs), "significant coefficients\n")
    return(kable(sig_coefs, digits = 4, caption = paste("Significant Coefficients -", response_var)) |>
             kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped"))
  } else {
    cat("No significant coefficients (p < 0.05)\n")
    return(kable(head(all_coefs, 5), digits = 4, caption = paste("Top Coefficients -", response_var)) |>
             kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped"))
  }
}

```

```{r}
run_logistic(df, "aware")
run_logistic(df, "granted")
```
